paragraphs: Abba Tahana Hasida, who put down his bundle and brought in a person afflicted with boils at twilight on Sabbath eve. God made the sun shine for him, and a heavenly voice went forth, “Go, eat with joy”: Kohelet Rabbah, at “Go, eat with joy,” and so forth.
